independent_review.review_mode: Read-only source, tests and execution-accounting inspection; no model run
independent_review.conclusion: No blocking timeout, interruption or accounting defect found for the pinned single-process qualifier.

verified_boundaries: One owned child, no retry; process timer begins before Popen and initial model imports.
Case timer begins at emitted monotonic case_started, includes tensorization, actual and reference forwards, assertions and case result writes.
Late case completion is rejected even when start and completion are first observed in the same polling read.
Whole process and case limits cannot exceed 1800 and 120 seconds respectively.
Frozen command, manifest, supplied source/authority/interpreter pins are retained before child launch and rechecked after.
Startup failures, between-case failures, active-case failures and partial next starts preserve distinct case accounting.
No fabricated NEI prediction, empty evidence result or benchmark success represents execution failure.
Owned child kill and wait precede final case accounting. Source preservation failure overrides overall success.
limitations: Only the owned child PID is killed; the qualified child must use no subprocess workers.
Preflight source hashing and parent final hashing/terminal writes are cooperative local I/O outside the child deadline.
Process scheduling and bounded event-file reads can add polling latency.
Long-case input construction precedes case_started and is covered by the whole-process cap rather than the case cap.
The root must provide the full source/authority closure in pins; the helper additionally requires interpreter, supervisor and child entrypoint pins.
